package probe

// census-want: 0
// The production shape: the wire function runs only inside the attempt.

import "github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/llm"

func (c *call) attempt(runCtx context.Context, b *backends.Backend, lease *dispatch.Lease, t time.Duration) error {
	_, err := llm.ChatRaw(runCtx, *b, nil, t, 0)
	return err
}

func (c *call) walk(ctx context.Context, chain []backends.Backend) {
	_, _, _ = llm.WalkChain(ctx, chain, "chat", c.acq, nil, llm.WalkRules{},
		func(runCtx context.Context, b *backends.Backend, lease *dispatch.Lease, t time.Duration) (dispatch.Usage, bool, error) {
			return dispatch.Usage{}, false, c.attempt(runCtx, b, lease, t)
		})
}
